description: error.rs defines StorageError with variants like Database(String), CorruptData(String), etc. All DB errors pass through .to_string() at the point of conversion (From<sqlx::Error> or inline). Callers cannot programmatically distinguish a unique constraint violation from a connection error or a timeout — all become opaque strings. This forces grep-based error handling in tests and makes it impossible to write precise match arms. Provide structured variants (e.g., StorageError::UniqueViolation, StorageError::ConnectionFailed) and preserve the original error as a source.
title: core: StorageError erases all structured error information as String
